author: NewVoltdrive
body:
I'm sorry to say, and I'm happy for schemmi that the map got accepted. But many people in CTH don't like the map. Mainly because it is too plain and too big. I personally agree with this. So here are my suggestions:
-Edit the map to give it more detail and shrink it a bit.
or
-Remove it
Sorry, but it is a common opinion of the CTH players.
